arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
R=/home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime
E=/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680
echo 'REA_HYGIENE_PHASE=read_only'
printf 'HOST=%s USER=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
if test -x "$R/bin/rea-mcp"; then echo 'MCP_ENTRYPOINT=present'; else echo 'MCP_ENTRYPOINT=MISSING'; fi
if test -f "$E/scripts/rea.mjs"; then echo 'REA_ORIGINAL_SOURCE=present'; else echo 'REA_ORIGINAL_SOURCE=MISSING'; fi
if test -f "$E/package.json"; then
 node_ver="$(command -v node || true)"
 printf 'REA_ENGINE_PACKAGE_VERSION=%s\n' "$(grep -m1 '"version"' "$E/package.json" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')"
fi
for spec in \
  "$R/bin/rea-mcp:fbea5e89bf11248a81ee6cefc8ff19cc6612dacf:LAUNCHER" \
  "$R/docs/OPERATIONS.md:d033dc2c947c601d9161b2a48d3f34b5f488a769:OPERATIONS" \
  "$R/docs/README.md:2d422c02220f8fed49c71a14abed4c342ced5e07:README"; do
  IFS=: read -r file expected label <<< "$spec"
  if test -f "$file"; then
    actual="$(git hash-object "$file")"
    if test "$actual" = "$expected"; then printf '%s_VERSION=SYNC\n' "$label"; else printf '%s_VERSION=DRIFT expected=%s actual=%s\n' "$label" "$expected" "$actual"; fi
  else
    printf '%s_VERSION=MISSING\n' "$label"
  fi
done
bash -n "$R/bin/rea-mcp" && echo 'LAUNCHER_BASH_SYNTAX=pass'
for dir in "$E" "$R"; do
  printf 'DIRECTORY=%s\n' "$dir"
  if git -C "$dir" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'GIT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse HEAD)"
    dirty="$(git -C "$dir" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
    printf 'GIT_TRACKED_MODIFICATIONS=%s\n' "$dirty"
  else
    echo 'GIT_WORKTREE=not_a_repository'
  fi
done
echo 'REA_HOME_CANDIDATE_DIRECTORIES_START'
find /home/ubuntu -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d \( -iname '*rea*' -o -iname '*reversa*' \) -printf '%f\n' | sort
echo 'REA_HOME_CANDIDATE_DIRECTORIES_END'
echo 'REA_TMP_CANDIDATES_START'
find /tmp -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'rea-final-mcp-*' -user ubuntu -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM %f\n' | sort
echo 'REA_TMP_CANDIDATES_END'
echo 'REA_DUPLICATE_PROCESS_INSTANCES_START'
ps -eo user=,pid=,comm=,args= | awk '$1=="ubuntu" && ($3=="node" || $3=="python3") && index($0,"rea.mjs") > 0 { print $2,$3 }' | head -15
echo 'REA_DUPLICATE_PROCESS_INSTANCES_END'
echo 'REA_HYGIENE_READ_ONLY_COMPLETE=pass'
